label: Some single admitted quality has n pairwise numerically distinct Forms…, by Finite-list-induction
meaning: Starting from a mutual resemblance pair, obtain a common Form. Participation-to-likeness and symmetry make the new Form mutually resemble all old members; numerical nonidentity gives freshness. Iteration keeps the list eligible. Repeating this construction yields arbitrary finite lists of distinct likeness Forms, without ordinary self-predication or ordinary F-homogeneity.
